title: October Horror — themed nights, four streaming tracks

dayThemes.1: Home is where the horror is

metadataNotes: US streaming matrix: four intensity tracks every night of October.
Each night has an editorial theme; films stay on their intensity track.
Service names are subscription-tier snapshots; watch URLs are not included in this matrix export.
Availability changes; confirm on the service before planning a night.
Intensity follows the source track labels (light, creepy/atmospheric as moderate, intense).
